description: This source file defines a route handler for logging out users in a Remix-based web application. It provides an action to destroy the user session token and redirect to the login page, and a minimal React component for the route.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Handles the logout process by destroying the session token and redirecting to /login.

methods.description: React component for the logout route, renders nothing since logout is handled by the action.
